parrafo.es: Sittin Pretty lleva años cuidando perros en el corazón de Kissimmee, FL: baños, cortes completos, cortes por raza y cuidado de uñas, con la paciencia que necesitan hasta los más nerviosos. Respaldado por la calificación de 4.9 en Google que dejaron 103 clientes.
parrafo.en: Sittin Pretty has spent years caring for dogs in the heart of downtown Kissimmee, FL: baths, full grooms, breed-specific cuts and nail care, with the patience that even the most nervous dogs need. Backed by the 4.9 rating 103 customers left on Google.

hero.imagen_alt: Groomer at Sittin Pretty working with a large Bernese Mountain Dog on the grooming table

parrafo_1.es: Sittin Pretty es un salón de grooming canino en pleno downtown de Kissimmee, FL. Brenda y su equipo bañan, cortan y cepillan perros de todos los tamaños, con especial cuidado para los más nerviosos y los de piel sensible.
parrafo_1.en: Sittin Pretty is a dog grooming salon right in downtown Kissimmee, FL. Brenda and her team bathe, cut and brush dogs of every size, with extra patience for the nervous ones and those with sensitive skin.

parrafo_2.es: Clientes llevan casi 20 años trayendo a sus perros aquí, confiando en el mismo equipo generación tras generación de mascotas. Respaldado por una calificación de 4.9 en Google con 103 reseñas.
parrafo_2.en: Customers have been bringing their dogs here for almost 20 years, trusting the same team through one generation of pets after another. Backed by a 4.9 rating on Google from 103 reviews.

titulo.es: Llamas y cuentas de tu perro
titulo.en: Call and tell us about your dog

texto.es: Nos dices raza, tamaño y temperamento al (407) 343-8525, y si tiene alguna sensibilidad que debamos conocer.
texto.en: Tell us the breed, size and temperament at (407) 343-8525, and any sensitivity we should know about.

texto.es: Coordinamos día y hora dentro de nuestro horario de martes a sábado en downtown Kissimmee.
texto.en: We coordinate a day and time within our Tuesday to Saturday schedule in downtown Kissimmee.

titulo.en: Bath and cut, at their pace

texto.es: Trabajamos con paciencia real, sobre todo con los perros mayores, nerviosos o de piel sensible.
texto.en: We work with real patience, especially with older dogs, nervous ones, or those with sensitive skin.

texto.es: Lo recoges bañado, cortado y tranquilo, respaldado por nuestra calificación en Google.
texto.en: You pick them up bathed, trimmed and relaxed, backed by our rating on Google.

nota.es: Cada precio depende de la raza, el tamaño y el estado del pelaje. Llámanos y te damos el detalle antes de agendar.
nota.en: Every price depends on the breed, size and coat condition. Call us and we will walk you through it before you book.

texto.es: Baño, corte, secado y cepillado completo, adaptado a la raza y el largo del pelaje de tu perro.
texto.en: Bath, haircut, drying and full brush-out, tailored to your dog's breed and coat length.

texto.es: Cortes tradicionales de schnauzer, poodle y otras razas, con el estilo que tu perro siempre ha usado.
texto.en: Traditional schnauzer, poodle and other breed cuts, kept consistent with the style your dog already wears.

texto.es: Baño y secado con atención especial en perros de piel sensible o zonas delicadas.
texto.en: Bath and drying with extra care around sensitive skin and delicate areas.

texto.es: Corte de uñas y los toques finales que dejan a tu perro listo para salir a pasear.
texto.en: Nail trims and the finishing touches that leave your dog ready to go for a walk.

pie.es: ¿Tu perro es mayor o se pone nervioso en el groomer? Cuéntanos, lo atendemos con paciencia real.
pie.en: Is your dog older or does it get nervous at the groomer? Tell us, we handle it with real patience.

items.quote: Miss Brenda and Bradley are some of the best people in the world and we have been lucky enough to use them for almost 20 years now grooming all of our dogs in our family. They have been a part of all our dogs lives and groomed every single dog we've ever owned they do the best job and they take the best care of your animals.

What an incredible place. Brenda and her staff do an Incredible job of taking care of my fur baby. Their professionalism and genuine care for the pets is evident at every visit. If I could give them ten stars I would.

It was the first time going here with my fur baby Ziva. Brenda came highly recommended. Ziva is 10, she does not like her feet or face touched and is always nervous. She looks amazing. We will be back for sure.

texto.en: Tell us about your dog and we will schedule your visit.
